readout_other: ADAS-J cog (primary); CDR sum of boxes; NPIQ-J; J-ZBI; WMS-R; MMSE-J; FAQ; safety MRI
direction_notes: Worsening of ADAS-J cog tended to be suppressed in the LIPUS group versus placebo at week 72, not statistically significant (P = 0.257).
safety_notes: No adverse events or abnormal MRI findings in the roll-in or RCT trials; MRI at 12 weeks (roll-in) and 72 weeks (RCT).

exposures.label: Whole-brain LIPUS via bilateral temporal bones

target.label: whole brain through the bilateral temporal bones

timing.protocol_description: LIPUS 20 min, 3 times with a 5 min interval each time; one session is therapy every other day for 3 days; 32 cycles per pulse, duty cycle 5%, PRF 781 Hz (interval 1.28 msec). RCT: 6 sessions at 3-month intervals.

source_quotes.n_subjects: In the RCT trial, where 22 patients were initially enrolled (11 in each group), 3 in the placebo group withdrew the consent, and thus 11 in the LIPUS group and 8 in the placebo group received the blinded procedure (Fig. 2, Table 1).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The LIPUS therapy was performed for one session in the roll-in trial, and 6 sessions in the RCT trial with 3-month intervals for 1.5 years.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: In the RCT trial, the conditions of the LIPUS therapy were as follows; frequency 0.5MHz, intensity 1.3MPa, wave number 32, duty cycle 5%, and pulse repetitive frequency (PRF) 781Hz with an interval of 1.28 msec
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: In the roll-in trial, the LIPUS therapy was performed for one session during admission under increasing condition of intensity from 0.5 MPa in one subject, 1.0 MPa in 2 subjects, and 1.3 MPa in 2 subjects
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: In the RCT trial, the conditions of the LIPUS therapy were as follows; frequency 0.5MHz, intensity 1.3MPa, wave number 32, duty cycle 5%, and pulse repetitive frequency (PRF) 781Hz with an interval of 1.28 msec
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: In the RCT trial, the conditions of the LIPUS therapy were as follows; frequency 0.5MHz, intensity 1.3MPa, wave number 32, duty cycle 5%, and pulse repetitive frequency (PRF) 781Hz with an interval of 1.28 msec
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The LIPUS therapy was performed for 20 min 3 times with an interval of 5 min each time.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Briefly, this probe was set to have an Ispta of 0.15-0.19 MPa at the deepest part (hippocampus; depth of about 8 cm).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: In the RCT trial, the conditions of the LIPUS therapy were as follows; frequency 0.5MHz, intensity 1.3MPa, wave number 32, duty cycle 5%, and pulse repetitive frequency (PRF) 781Hz with an interval of 1.28 msec (Fig. 1) (Eguchi et al. 2018).

flags.reason: Roll-in trial N = 5 and RCT enrolled N = 22 (19 analysed); total exposed not stated, group sizes listed.
Roll-in escalated 0.5, 1.0, 1.3 MPa; RCT used 1.3 MPa. Domain not stated (the probe design text discusses Ispta values in MPa below the skull and at depth, not used here).
Pulse described as 32 cycles at 0.5 MHz; a pulse duration in ms is not stated, so left not_reported.
20 min x 3 with 5 min intervals; unclear whether each 20 min is one uninterrupted train. The abstract also says 'one hour 3 times a week as one session'.
Convex diffusion-type probe developed by the group; maker not named.
